thread:
Logan (Acct Mgmt): Aurelia Labs flagged a surprise overage on their March dedicated commit invoice (INV-20260307-AUR). They9re seeing ~14% over expected GPU-hours and want a line-item breakdown + any SLA credit applied. Can we confirm root cause?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20260307-AUR created for acct-AUR-998 (total $31,320).

Asha (Finance): Can you confirm the account id and reserved commit tier so I can pull the metering export?

Logan (Acct Mgmt): acct-AUR-998, reserved commit = 1x p4d-equivalent pool (monthly). Customer says commit should cover 1,200 GPU-hours, invoice shows 1,430 billed GPU-hours.

devon (Billing Eng): Pulled ETL logs. There9s a short window 2026-03-02T00:50:00Z -> 2026-03-02T04:10:00Z where the autoscaler failover caused duplicate burst emissions in eu-west-1. ~= 45 GPU-hours duplicated.

Asha (Finance): Great. Can you run numbers for reserved vs burst and a suggested credit?

devon (Billing Eng): Numbers from metering export: 
``nReserved commit cap: 1,200 GPU-hours
Metered reserved usage: 1,200 GPU-hours
Raw burst recorded: 230 GPU-hours
Identified duplicate inflation: 45 GPU-hours
Net burst after dedupe: 185 GPU-hours
Unit price (burst): $15.00 / GPU-hour
Gross burst charge: $3,450.00
Credit for duplicated meters: -$675.00
SLA credit (pro-rated): $4,500.00
Net overage / refund due: -$1,725.00``
(note: negative means refund to customer after credits)

Asha (Finance): That matches my quick calc. Invoice currently shows $3,450 in burst + reserved lines. After dedupe and SLA credit we owe them $1,725. I will prepare a pro-forma credit note.

trevor (Sales): Please keep Aurelia updated. They want an ETA  can we commit to when this will be resolved? :eyes: 

Asha (Finance): I will post the credit note by EOD and reissue the adjusted invoice tomorrow morning PST. Accounting will process refund/offset within 5 business days of customer acceptance.

Logan (Acct Mgmt): I9ll send the breakdown + pro-forma to the customer and note the timeline. cc @trevor.

devon (Billing Eng): Root cause: autoscaler double-ack during node swap caused duplicate emission. Fix patch queued and will be deployed with next billing pipeline roll tomorrow. Ill also add a one-off reconciler to catch similar dupes in March. :white_check_mark: 

Asha (Finance): Assigning FIN-4671 to track the credit issuance and invoice reissue.

Logan (Acct Mgmt): Thanks all, will update once Aurelia confirms. :thumbsup:
